markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (78%)** · Confident · Careful review
The conformal set holds one class, but the second model and all 5 neighbors disagree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 78%, Invasive 18% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu | No matching neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term; lowers invasive association [F2] · Unreliable (0/20)
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links this to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Score is low, so it lowers invasive association · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test excludes 0 (drop 0.54 logit, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Second model and all 5 neighbors disagree with InSitu.
- Region 8's per-region probe reads 89% invasive; invasive overall is 18%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8** — per-region probe reads 89% invasive; look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 6, 7** — confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
3. **Regions 9, 10, 11** — check whether lobules are truly normal; concept failed spot check.
